It holds sushi and spring rolls, a fruit cup, a chicken salad sandwich with a cookie, a soy sauce cup, and three drinks (orange juice, a pale juice, and water).

**STEP 3 - Items:** Spring rolls (3), sushi rolls (~6-7 pieces), mixed fruit cup (watermelon, papaya, orange), chicken salad sandwich on a bun, chocolate chip cookie, soy sauce, orange juice, pale fruit juice, water.
